decisions.rationale: Adds a concrete caller/data-flow and risk review procedure. Complete named sections are generated, never pasted by hand.
Original Paprika wording; proceed on reasonable reversible assumptions, ask only on material blockers. Do not redistribute upstream prose until standalone licensing is resolved.
Prefer existing helpers and platform capabilities while preserving required validation, recovery, security and accessibility.
Require concrete reachable failures and evidence limits. Use Paprika reporting; a ship recommendation grants no publishing authority. A shortcut cannot excuse violating required behavior.
Human grants, independent review and concise communication already apply; do not install competing global policy.

licensing.ponytail: MIT; exact root LICENSE preserved with extracted procedure
licensing.karpathy_guidelines: MIT declared in skill metadata; no standalone license at pin; ideas adapted in original Paprika wording only

updates: Review selected inputs, support files and upstream license changes; revise the adaptation deliberately; run integrity and behavior checks plus representative baseline comparison before adopting a new pin. No automatic upgrades.
evidence: Pilot candidate. Packaging and installer checks do not demonstrate improved review quality or token/time savings.
